title: Record the printed rank-7 pattern cover
body:
## Summary
- The ten printed rank-7 patterns cover nine copies of the width inventory `{4:26, 5:2, 6:16, 7:52, 8:99, 9:213}` on every width: 234, 18, 144, 468, 891 and 1917 slots.
- Those six widths cover 3,672 slots, and the ten multiplicities sum to 2,016. The printed swap has width multiset `{7,7,8,8,9,9}` on both sides.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
